report.explanation: Current gateway telemetry is healthy and contradicts the alert: traces show OK checkout at 69ms, metrics show error_rate 0.0014 and p95 80ms, logs show status 200. No downstream service telemetry is available, so no public cause can be substantiated. Handing off with the observations required to bound a candidate.
missing_evidence: Gateway telemetry shows healthy checkout (error_rate 0.0014, p95 80ms, status OK); need evidence of the actual error/latency spike to locate the failing service.
No telemetry from order, inventory, payment, postgresql, or redis; need per-service error rates and latencies to test downstream-latency or db-pool-exhaustion.
Need db_pool_waiters and dependency_timeouts from order/postgresql to assess db-pool-exhaustion.
Need redis latency/timeout metrics from inventory to assess redis-timeout.
Need deployment records and config diffs to assess bad-configuration.
Need memory-retention time series per service to assess memory-leak.
